login_wrong: That name and password do not match.
login_throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
login_refused: This sign-in did not come from this page. Open the app's address and sign in again.
nav_tickets_later: The tickets screen comes later. Create a ticket from the tower.
signed_out: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
load_failed: Cannot reach the service right now. This page tries again on its own.
notify_unavailable: Notifications cannot be turned on here.
notify_devices_one: {n} device is told when something waits for you.
notify_devices_other: {n} devices are told when something waits for you.
notify_ios: On iPhone and iPad, notifications need the app on the Home Screen: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, open Cleared from there, sign in and turn them on.
notify_blocked: This browser blocks the app's notifications: allow them in its settings, then come back.
notify_insecure: Notifications need the app's https address. Open the app from that address to turn them on.
notify_no_subject: The service has no address to sign notifications with yet. The notifications section of the v2 README says how to give it one.
notify_config: The service's notification settings cannot be read. The notifications section of the v2 README lists them.
notify_store: The service's notification folder cannot be used: it must be private to the service's account (mode 0700).
notify_failed: Notifications could not be turned on. Try again.
notify_off_failed: Notifications could not be turned off. Try again.
notify_ready_body: This device will be told when something waits for you.
